item.title: Person of Interest
item.description:
📝 Person of Interest 07 Nov, 2026 A few days ago, I started watching Person of Interest, and I haven’t been able to stop. Aside from the fact that the show feels even more relevant today than it did 15 years ago, when it first aired, it’s brought back so many memories of the early 2010s, when I first started getting into tech and developing an interest in computers. But beyond all that, watching it has made me incredibly nostalgic, and considering it’s already 15 years old, I think it’s aged remarkably well.
🔗 Read more: https://krthr.co/person-of-interest/

item.title: Petered (what happens after the Peter Principle)
item.description:
📝 The Peter Principle posits that people are promoted until they reach their level of incompetence. What happens after that point. The Principle posits that individuals in hierarchical organizations are promoted until they reach their level of incompetence, where they can no longer perform effectively and cease to advance.
🔗 Read more: https://aworkinglibrary.com/writing/petered
